check.rationale: Validates files for formatting without modifying any state.

config.rationale: Parent command for configuration management; its subcommands (init, update, add, edit) all modify the configuration file.

file-paths.rationale: Only inspects and prints resolved file paths based on configuration; makes no modifications to files or state.

fmt.rationale: Writes formatted code to the file system; bounded, expected, and reversible.
